ipsec_natt_endpoint_detected.title: IPsec NAT-Traversal Endpoint Detected (UDP/4500)
ipsec_natt_endpoint_detected.description: An IPsec endpoint is responding to IKE handshakes on UDP/4500, which is the NAT-Traversal encapsulation port. This indicates IPsec with NAT-T is configured — common for any VPN that must traverse NAT.
ipsec_natt_endpoint_detected.impact: Information disclosure: confirms the host is acting as an IPsec VPN gateway. Combined with weak-crypto findings from the IKE catalog (3DES, SHA1, modp1024, etc.), this becomes a security concern. The NAT-T endpoint typically uses the same SA proposal as UDP/500.
ipsec_natt_endpoint_detected.remediation: If this endpoint is not intended to be publicly reachable, restrict UDP/4500 at the perimeter firewall. Otherwise, ensure the IPsec configuration uses strong crypto (AES-256, SHA-256, DH group 14 or higher) and disables aggressive mode. See the corresponding IKE/500 findings for crypto-specific remediation.
ipsec_natt_endpoint_detected.evidence_template: ike-scan against {{host}}:4500 with --nat-t received IKE handshake response
